newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil lower on falling crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil lower on falling crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil could not resist the downward pull of weaker crude on Wednesday.
Dealers said activity was slow as buyers steered clear of picking up material.
"Better to be safe than sorry and get it cheaper tomorrow," said one dealer. Demand was viewed as only half hearted with the incentive lost for refiners to run fuel oil against crude.
Prices were pegged in the high $130s to low $140s fob NWE. The Russian straight run sector was also suffering from muted interest with E-4 assessed around the mid $120s cif.
